typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EventDate as string,
		Deal_Tracking_Num as string,
		Toolset as string,
		Ins_Type as string,
		Name as string,
		Short_Name as string,
		{Internal/External} as string,
		Type_of_Event as string,
		Trade_Time as string,
		Trader_Name as string,
		Executed_by as string,
		Marketer_Name as string,
		Trade_Event_Category as string,
		Action_Interval_Days as integer,
		Booked_to_New_By as string,
		New_Validated_By as string,
		FileName as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		DESK_NAME as string,
		tran_num as string,
		validatedAmended_by as string,
		validateAmend_reason as string,
		File_LoadDate as string,
		Reference as string,
		last_name as string,
		Title as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Trader_Name} = Trader_Name) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		EventDate as string,
		Trade_Time as string,
		FileName as string,
		File_LoadDate as string,
		Booked_to_New_By as string,
		Name as string,
		validatedAmended_by as string,
		Deal_Tracking_Num as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		Internal_External as string,
		Action_Interval_Days as integer,
		Reference as string,
		Ins_Type as string,
		Executed_by as string,
		Marketer_Name as string,
		last_name as string,
		Title as string,
		Toolset as string,
		DESK_NAME as string,
		Type_of_Event as string,
		New_Validated_By as string,
		Short_Name as string,
		Trade_Event_Category as string,
		Trader_Name as string,
		tran_num as string,
		validateAmend_reason as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EventDate,
		Trade_Time,
		FileName,
		File_LoadDate,
		Booked_to_New_By,
		Name,
		validatedAmended_by,
		Deal_Tracking_Num,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		Internal_External = {Internal/External},
		Action_Interval_Days,
		Reference,
		Ins_Type,
		Executed_by,
		Marketer_Name,
		last_name,
		Title,
		Toolset,
		DESK_NAME,
		Type_of_Event,
		New_Validated_By,
		Short_Name,
		Trade_Event_Category,
		Trader_Name = {Copy of Trader_Name},
		tran_num,
		validateAmend_reason),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
